description: This file defines the HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Chameleon class, which manages conditional child definitions based on context (inline or block) within the HTMLPurifier library. It specializes in handling tags like 'del' and 'ins' that change behavior depending on context.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_ChildDef_Chameleon
classes.description: A class that dynamically switches between different child element definitions based on whether the context is inline or block, primarily for flexible tag handling such as 'del' and 'ins'.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Chameleon definition with specific inline and block element lists, wrapping them in optional definitions and setting up the elements from the block definition.

methods.name: validateChildren
methods.description: Validates child tokens based on context, delegating to either the inline or block definition as determined by the context's 'IsInline' property.
